newsitem.title: GERMANY: Veba-too early to say on chemicals unit turnaround.
newsitem.headline: Veba-too early to say on chemicals unit turnaround.

text.p: German diversified utility Veba AG said it was too early to tell whether its Huels chemicals unit would report earnings growth in 1997 in line with previous figures.
"It is too early in the year to tell if the situation at Huels is improving," Erhard Meyer-Galow, Huels AG's management board chairman.
Meyer-Galow said that despite an 8.5 percent fall in earnings to 460 million marks in 1996, measured using the DVFA analysts' standard, it had been "not a bad year".
The earnings drop was mostly due to weakness in the economy, the group said.

Huels made a turnaround in 1995, but was unable to maintain the trend in earnings growth in 1996. The group said that with only two months fully gone, it was too early to say whether the turnaround would continue in 1997.
